channel.title: AI at Work, Plainly
channel.description: Using AI tools at work carefully, with their limits in view.

item.title: Why AI Chatbots Make Things Up, and How to Catch It
item.description: What NIST and OpenAI say causes AI "hallucinations," why confident answers can still be wrong, and practical checks before you use AI output at work.

item.title: AI Notetakers in Meetings, What Recording Consent Actually Means
item.description: A plain explanation of how Zoom and Microsoft Teams implement recording consent, and why some US states legally require everyone's consent to record.

item.title: Privacy Questions to Ask Before Using an AI Tool at Work
item.description: A checklist of privacy questions drawn from official OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google documentation to ask before adopting an AI tool at work.

item.title: Using AI to Draft Emails, What the Official Docs Say
item.description: What OpenAI and Microsoft officially document about business data handling when you use AI tools to draft workplace emails.

item.title: What Happens to a Document You Paste into an AI Tool
item.description: What OpenAI's and Microsoft's own enterprise privacy documentation say about training, storage, and access when you summarize a work document with AI.
